name: Medium 6-Inch White Textured Ceramic-Style Cylinder Planter Pot
description: Selling a stylish medium 6-inch cylinder planter pot in a clean, minimalist textured white finish. Features a unique honeycomb geometric tactile pattern that catches the light beautifully on windowsill displays. Ideal for medium-sized succulents, pothos, herbs, or snake plants. Shows minor surface organic stains on the bottom rim from regular watering but has no structural cracks. Coming from a pet-friendly home with a cat; the planter has been vacuumed, thoroughly hosed clean externally, and wiped with sanitizer.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled gardening accessory. Does NOT come with an additional retail fabric storage bag. Local pickup buyers are highly encouraged to bring a small cardboard box or plastic bag for transport. Comes from a cat-friendly home, fully hosed down and disinfected externally before transfer.
meta_description: Medium 6-inch white textured cylinder planter pot. Modern geometric look, perfect for succulents or snake plants. Cleaned and hosed down for sale.
name_zh: 中号 6寸简约立体压花纹理白色直筒花盆
description_zh: 转让一个极简现代风的中号6寸直筒花盆，干净的纯白配色搭配精美细腻的几何蜂窝压花纹理，放在桌上或窗台采光处非常高级。尺寸适合栽种中型多肉、绿萝、薄荷或虎皮兰。底部因日常浇水有极轻微的泥水沉积痕迹，整体完好无损。卖家家里养猫，发货前已将外部进行冲洗并用酒精消毒擦拭。
